systems.platform: offline, mobile-first application built by IHM Southern Africa, linked to the Eswatini Population Register
systems.owner: Ministry of Health (HMIS Unit and Community-Based Health Program), funded by the World Bank Human Capital Development Project, with UNICEF
systems.tiers: Rural Health Motivators at community level; piloted in Mpolonjeni Constituency, Lubombo; launched 26 September 2025 with scaling to all regions to follow; interoperable with the HIE and CMIS

note: The document is about the launch of CBHIS, a community-class system, on 26 September 2025; it says CBHIS is interoperable with CMIS (bearing on the community-integrated flag) but names CMIS without saying what it does, and states nothing about an HMIS or EMR.
